_purpose: LUMIRA layout defaults for values the rule profile does not define. Kept separate so rule-profile.json can be replaced without losing them. Every block has a _source; the app shows its trust tag.

room_type_to_profile._source: design choice — maps LUMIRA room types to rule-profile lighting_design.target_lux keys. utility and other have no key, so they get a 'not in rule profile' warning.

sockets_per_room._source: unverified — LUMIRA design default (typical UK new-build practice), not from BS 7671 or the rule profile. Replace with your own values. Bathroom/WC are 0 because of the Section 701 socket distance rule.

placement_cm._source: design choice — plan positions only; mounting heights come from rule-profile sockets

installation_methods.C: Method C: clipped direct, or buried in plaster/masonry
installation_methods.A: Method A: in conduit in a thermally insulated wall
installation_methods.100: Method 100: above a plasterboard ceiling, insulation up to 100 mm
installation_methods.101: Method 101: above a plasterboard ceiling, insulation over 100 mm
installation_methods.102: Method 102: in a stud wall with insulation, cable touching the wall
installation_methods.103: Method 103: in a stud wall with insulation, cable not touching the wall

wiring._methods_source: secondary — BS 7671 Appendix 4 reference methods as described in cable datasheets; Iz values come from rule-profile cables
wiring._route_source: design choice — plan route length x factor + vertical drops for a 2.7 m ceiling (sockets: one drop, then chained in the wall); measure on site
wiring._rccb_source: design choice — standard 2-pole RCCB sizes; Type A for electronic loads (rule-profile rcd.types)
wiring._board_source: design choice — typical DIN module widths, 13-module rows, at least 20% spare ways
wiring._cu_source: design choice — near the load centre on an outside wall, preferably hall/utility/garage, never in a bathroom or WC

bom._source: design choice — purchase allowance for offcuts and terminations on top of the estimated route lengths
